reader_summary.headline: It's surprising that how (and what) we eat has actually changed very little over the ages.
reader_summary.overview: It's surprising that how (and what) we eat has actually changed very little over the ages, despite how much we’ve advanced as a species. Now, however -- driven by globalization, environmental factors, and other considerations -- the way we move, taste, and make our food is moving forward too. including how we define what “food”really is.
